average_checkpoints_from_files: average multiple PyTorch checkpoint files and write the averaged model weights to a new checkpoint
average_last_n_epoch_checkpoints: average the last N epoch-based checkpoint files from a directory and save the result
average_last_n_update_checkpoints: average the last N update-based checkpoint files from a directory and save the result
average_checkpoints_with_upper_bound: average checkpoints up to a specified epoch or update upper bound from a directory
list_matching_checkpoints_in_dir: list and filter checkpoint files in a directory by epoch or update number patterns
